تستضعفي (form X)
# تَسْتَضْعِفِي (tastaḍʕifī) /tas.tadˤ.ʕi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
# تُسْتَضْعَفِي (tustaḍʕafī) /tus.tadˤ.ʕa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَضْعَفَ (istaḍʕafa)
